item.name: Send a new credentialing outreach email

request.name: Send a new credentialing outreach email

description.content: Sends a credentialing outreach email to one or more email addresses, with optional CC, BCC, reply-to, and attachments. The 'toEmails' field accepts a list of email addresses directly.

response.name: Outreach email sent successfully. Two response shapes are possible: (1) Multi-tenant request (workflowIds.size > 1): body is MultiTenantOutreachResult with fields outreachId (String) and sends (PerWorkflowSendStatus[]). (2) Single-workflow request: body is a bare String containing the outreach record ID.
